mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tbl_member ORDER BY no DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_member (username, password, email, birthYear, regDate, updatedDate) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{birthYear}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_member SET username = #{username}, password = #{password}, email = #{email}, birthYear = #{birthYear}, updatedDate = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE no = #{no}
